pages.text: Mod plants, blocks and slabs of grass, mycelium, podzol and nylium have a new state - FERTILE. By default the block has this state set to TRUE and it can be changed by using shears or pruner without the '$(6)Silk Touch$()' enchant.$(br)

$(br)Changing the state to FALSE on plants causes them to be unable to grow, including by using meal on them, and on the remaining blocks that they cannot spread. Using bonemeal while in the FALSE state will switch it back to the TRUE state.$(br)
$(br)If the mod '$(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jade)$(2)Jade'$()$()' is installed, it will show information about the current state.$(br)
